_comment: Canonical, single source of truth for the vehicle signal catalog. Both the firmware (via tools/gen_catalog.py -> core/vehicle/src/signal_catalog.generated.inc) and the Mac monitor tool (tools/monitor) read this file. Byte fields are UDS read-data-by-identifier (service 0x22) DID pairs. A signal's displayed value is transform(over each request's (raw + offset) * scale). 'transform' names a C++ function (transform_<name>) defined in signal_catalog.cpp AND a Python function in tools/monitor; 'default' returns request 0's value. Edit here, then run tools/gen_catalog.py. OPTIONAL per-request keys: 'ecu' {tx, rx} -- the CAN ids the request goes out on and is answered on (which module owns the DID; required for an active signal); 'field' {start, len, signed, bit_shift, bit_len} -- read len big-endian bytes from start, optionally narrowed to a bit sub-field, so several signals can share one multi-value DID (omitted = legacy decode: 1-byte payload unsigned, else first two bytes signed). OPTIONAL per-signal keys: 'description' -- one plain sentence on what the signal is, shown on the phone configurator (gen_catalog.py writes the active signals' into platform/esp32/web/index.html; 'notes' stay the decoding scratchpad); 'enum' [{value, label}] for unit 'Enum'; 'points' [{payload, value|label, note, source, at}] -- raw/true reference pairs kept for fitting and later review. gen_catalog.py refuses active signals using anything the firmware can't decode yet. CADENCE FLOOR: no signal polls faster than 50ms. The five signals below that were previously at 20ms -- Int Pres (4), Engine Speed (7), Engine Torque (8), Throttle Pos (12), Int Pres Act. (22) -- were raised to 50ms on 2026-08-25 to match INFO_SCREEN_REFRESH_MS (src/main.cpp), since the display restates values at 20Hz. 'cycle_time_ms' is a FLOOR, not a fixed period: core::SignalPoller polls only the signals currently on a panel, one request outstanding at a time, so a signal is asked for no faster than this and slower whenever the ECU cannot serve full demand. Lowering these back to 20 would not put 20ms of traffic on the bus -- it would only raise their share of whatever throughput the ECU gives. See core/vehicle/README.md.

signals.name: Cool Temp
signals.description: Engine coolant temperature.

signals.name: Eng Oil Temp
signals.description: Engine oil temperature, measured by the oil temperature sensor in the oil pan.

signals.name: Int Air Temp
signals.description: Temperature of the air going into the engine.

signals.name: Charge Pres
signals.description: Charge-air (boost) pressure ahead of the throttle, as absolute pressure: it reads atmospheric pressure with the engine off.

signals.name: Int Pres
signals.description: Intake manifold pressure after the throttle, as absolute pressure: atmospheric with the engine off, below it at idle, above it on boost.

signals.name: Amb Pres
signals.description: Outside air (barometric) pressure. Drops as altitude rises.

signals.name: Boost
signals.description: Intake manifold pressure minus outside air pressure. Below zero is vacuum, above zero is boost.

signals.name: Engine Speed
signals.description: Engine RPM.

signals.name: Engine Torque
signals.description: Engine torque as the engine computer calculates it, not measured at the wheels.

signals.name: Speed
signals.description: Vehicle speed, as the engine computer reports it.

signals.name: Fuel Vol
signals.description: Fuel left in the tank, as a volume.

signals.name: Fuel Pct
signals.description: Fuel left in the tank, as a percentage of a full tank.

signals.name: Throttle Pos
signals.description: Actual position of the throttle body. This is the throttle itself, not the gas pedal.

signals.name: Misfire Cnt
signals.description: Misfires counted across all cylinders. Will reset periodically.

signals.name: Misfire Cnt Cyl 1
signals.description: Misfires counted on cylinder 1.

signals.name: Misfire Cnt Cyl 2
signals.description: Misfires counted on cylinder 2.

signals.name: Misfire Cnt Cyl 3
signals.description: Misfires counted on cylinder 3.

signals.name: Misfire Cnt Cyl 4
signals.description: Misfires counted on cylinder 4.

signals.name: Time Corr. Cyl 1
signals.description: Knock-control timing correction on cylinder 1. Away from zero means ignition timing is being pulled because of knock.

signals.name: Time Corr. Cyl 2
signals.description: Knock-control timing correction on cylinder 2. Away from zero means ignition timing is being pulled because of knock.

signals.name: Time Corr. Cyl 3
signals.description: Knock-control timing correction on cylinder 3. Away from zero means ignition timing is being pulled because of knock.

signals.name: Time Corr. Cyl 4
signals.description: Knock-control timing correction on cylinder 4. Away from zero means ignition timing is being pulled because of knock.

signals.name: Oil Fill Level
signals.description: Engine oil level, from the oil level sensor in the oil pan.
signals.notes:
Units are inches
[2026-10-29] Unit set to Length (stored in mm, shown in inches in imperial); scale x25.4 so the existing inch calibration now yields mm.

signals.name: Rad Out Temp
signals.description: Coolant temperature at the radiator outlet.

signals.name: Engine Outlet Coolant Temp
signals.description: The coolant temperature the engine computer is targeting at the engine outlet.

signals.name: Cool Temp Delta
signals.description: How much hotter the coolant is leaving the engine than leaving the radiator: the heat the radiator is taking out.
signals.notes:
Coolant temperature difference between engine and radiator
These vals are in F not C
[2026-10-29] Unit set to Temp difference (stored in °C); scale /1.8 so the existing °F-difference calibration now yields °C.

signals.name: Modeled Oil Temp
signals.description: Engine oil temperature as the engine computer models it, not read from a sensor.

signals.name: Rad Fan 1
signals.description: Percent speed that radiator fan 1 is running at.

signals.name: Rad Fan 2
signals.description: Percent speed that radiator fan 2 is running at.

signals.name: IMRC Cmd
signals.description: Intake manifold runner flaps: the position the engine computer commands.

signals.name: IMRC Ack
signals.description: Intake manifold runner flaps: the position the flaps report back.

signals.name: Calc Oil Temp
signals.description: Engine oil temperature as the engine computer calculates it.

signals.name: Gear
signals.description: The gear the transmission is in. Shows None while a shift is in progress. Supports up to 7 gears for 7-speed transmissions.
signals.notes:
This needs to be an enum
8 = Shifting process active
0 = First gear
1  = Second gear

signals.name: EGT
signals.description: Exhaust gas temperature ahead of the catalytic converter.
signals.notes: Exhaust gas temperature before catalytic converter

signals.name: T Cool Valve
signals.description: Valve that lets engine coolant flow to the transmission: open or closed.

signals.name: T Oil Cooler Valve
signals.description: Transmission oil cooler valve: open or closed. N/A on cars without one.

signals.name: Trans Fluid Temp
signals.description: Transmission (DSG) fluid temperature. Not supported on MT cars.

signals.name: Clutch 1 Torque
signals.description: Specified torque at clutch 1 (odd gears).

signals.name: Clutch 2 Torque
signals.description: Specified torque at clutch 2 (even gears, reverse).

signals.name: Clutch Oil Temp
signals.description: DSG clutch temperature, measured at the oil thrown off the clutches.

signals.name: Clutch 2 Pres
signals.description: Hydraulic pressure on DSG clutch 2 (even gears, reverse).

signals.name: Clutch 1 Pres
signals.description: Hydraulic pressure on DSG clutch 1 (odd gears).
Brake pressure, from the brake booster's pressure sensor.
signals.notes:
Hydraulic brake booster
Contains information for a bunch of stuff, only brake pressure sensor 1 works
0 = 0 bar
c9e=32.3 bar

points.note: From notes; sensor bytes only, full payload not recorded
From notes; sensor bytes only, full payload not recorded

signals.description: Instrument cluster needle dimming level.
signals.notes:
Dimming channels instrument cluster
Contains:
Dimming characterist curve middle display main field
Dimming characteristic curce indicator lights
Dimming characteristic curve gauge/finger/hand
Dimming characteristic curve clock dial
Dimming characteristic curve bar graph and acc

All i care about is curve/finger/hand
Direct hex to decimal conversion of 3rd byte

signals.name: Battery Voltage
signals.description: 12 V battery voltage, from the car's battery monitor.

signals.name: Battery Current
signals.description: 12 V battery charge or discharge current, from the car's battery monitor.

signals.name: AWD Ctrl Temp
signals.description: Temperature of the Haldex control module.

signals.name: AWD Pump Curr
signals.description: Current drawn by the Haldex clutch pump.

signals.name: AWD Clutch Temp
signals.description: Haldex clutch temperature.

signals.name: AWD Clutch Status
signals.description: How far the Haldex clutch is engaged. Higher sends more torque to the rear axle.

signals.name: AWD Clutch PWM
signals.description: Duty cycle the Haldex module drives the clutch pump at.

signals.name: AWD Clutch Volt
signals.description: Voltage at the Haldex clutch pump.

signals.name: AWD Cool Fin Temp
signals.description: Temperature of the Haldex unit's cooling fins.

signals.name: AWD OvrTemp Time
signals.description: Time the Haldex unit has spent over its temperature limit.

signals.name: AWD Axle Delta
signals.description: Speed difference between the front and rear axles. Above zero means wheels are slipping.
Steering wheel angle.
signals.notes:
Steering angle sensor, angle
Contains steering angle and valid

signals.description: Steering torque from the driver, as the power steering measures it.
signals.notes:
Steering torque 2
Contains torque and valid

signals.name: F Axle Height
signals.description: Front suspension travel (ride height). Measured by ride height sensor on front axle.

signals.name: R Axle Height
signals.description: Rear suspension travel (ride height). Measured by ride height sensor on rear axle.

signals.name: Amb Light
signals.description: Outside light level.

signals.name: Dim Ctrl
signals.description: Instrument cluster dimming level. Follows the dash brightness control.
